escalation_reason: Whether uv add should produce a universal lock that needs metadata for all platforms (e.g. pywin32 for win32) when resolving against an offline --find-links index is a product decision for maintainers. The inconsistent resolver message ('only pywin32<304 is available' vs 'no versions of pywin32>=304') may be a separate small bug worth a look.
rationale: The reporter labelled this a bug, but uv add produces a universal (all-platform) lock by design, so it needs pywin32 metadata for sys_platform == 'win32' even on Linux. The offline --no-index --find-links index has no such wheel, so resolution fails. uv pip install only resolves for the current platform, which explains why it succeeds. The reproduction steps are complete, so no MRE is needed. The external-cause check is negative because the failure is in uv's resolver. Search_issues returned no matching earlier issues. search_uv_docs was rate-limited (HTTP 403) and returned no result, so the docs were not checked. The confidence is medium for that reason and because the bug-versus-enhancement call is close.
